derived_from: SKILL.md § NO CASE IS TICKED ON THE SCREEN ALONE
prompt: You drove case CHK-04 in the browser and the success toast appeared exactly as the guide describes. Record the result.
assertions: the case is not marked pass on the visible screen state alone
what the backend actually stored is checked before any pass verdict
a case whose backend state cannot be confirmed is not recorded as passing
